text: cortex R5: `accepted.sha256` is the digest the deciding Verified event graded (exit 0: the last passing verdict; exit 27: the adjudicated one), not a late re-read after the audit call and label append. The file is read once more before the run reports; if it no longer hashes to that digest, has none, or cannot be read, the run fails closed: exit 22 blocked, a stderr line, accepted: null, the file restored as found.
